findings.title: Inconsistent casing for zone identifier
findings.body: The new field `shipping_zone` uses UPPER_CASE while the rest of the module uses snake_case for identifiers (e.g., `order_id`, `destination`). According to custom instructions in 'Naming Consistency' (casing must follow existing module style): snake_case should be used for identifiers in this module.

summary.problem: The new `shipping_zone` field introduces an inconsistent casing style (UPPER_CASE) in a module that otherwise uses snake_case.
summary.done_well: The change adds a useful shipping zone identifier to the order confirmation response.
